description: The line plot titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset" illustrates the performance metrics of different model variants in the context of hate speech detection. The x-axis, labeled "Model Variants," is categorical, representing various configurations of the model, including "Full model (Ours)," "w/o Prompt," "w/o Augmentation," "w/o Attention," and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The y-axis, labeled "Metric (%)," is linear, with values ranging from approximately 56% to 66%. The plot features three lines, each representing a different metric: "Precision," "Recall," and "F1-score." The "Precision" line is colored blue, marked with circles, and has a solid line style. It starts at 65.78% for the "Full model (Ours)" and ends at 56.82% for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The "Recall" line is colored orange, also marked with circles, and has a solid line style, beginning at 65.45% and ending at 57.74%. The "F1-score" line is colored brown, marked with circles, and has a dashed line style, starting at 65.44% and ending at 57.74%. Data points are annotated above each marker, providing exact values for each metric at the different model variants. The plot does not include any section titles, and the axes are described together before each line plot description.
